product.name: Idle Fantasy Shop
product.description: An idle game about running a fantasy shop in Latchford, crafting goods and supplying its shelves.

audience: Returning players who want to know what they can do in version 0.12

changes.text: At Workshop level 10, plan three ordered crafting jobs with Crafting Batch. It runs the plan once, pausing when ingredients are missing and resuming when they arrive. It does not gather ingredients: your workers can supply them.
Advanced gathering puts pressure on a biome and slows later cycles. Resting a biome lets it recover. Basic brushwood, ashwood and reed gathering does not exhaust biomes.
Craft ten new goods, including waxed wraps, linen market bags and oak counter trays. Separate late-game shelf upgrades provide more shelf capacity.
Existing shops, workers, purchases, progress and random sequences carry forward. Export a backup from Settings before moving devices or clearing browser data.
[planned] More production skills and deeper trade.
